title: rk-choi-complete-positivity: exact Runge-Kutta/Choi admissibility calculations
description: Exact symbolic calculations, certified root brackets, sign charts, and figure-generation code for generator-conditioned complete-positivity regions of Runge-Kutta methods for qubit damping.
